batting.name: Priyansh Arya
batting.dismissal: c VG Arora b AD Russell

batting.name: P Simran Singh
batting.dismissal: c R Powell b VG Arora

batting.name: M Jansen
batting.dismissal: c VR Iyer b VG Arora

balls.text: He's missed a full toss and that is a top over from Russell. He backs away looking to thrash him over deep midwicket. Misses altogether.
Well bowled and equally well played and PBKS' 200 is up. Yorker outside leg stump, Inglis brings his bat down in time and squeezes this in the gap between deep square and deep fine leg
Low full toss tailing in on leg stump, he mistimes to deep midwicket. Again, just a run
Only a single. This is top stuff from Russell. Yorker on leg stump, that tailed back in once more. Inglis can only push it back towards the bowler
Drops short of Varun at short third. Fuller on middle stump, he looks for a reverse ramp, the ball balloons to Varun
Fuller-length ball outside off, he drives to extra cover
Whacked! Good length ball outside off, he stands tall and thumps him over extra cover for a one-bounce four
Tries to go the other way, but misses. On a length well outside off, close to the tramline. He looks for a pre-meditated scoop, can only toe-end to point
Wow, Inglish making me eat my words. Back of a length ball well outside off, he plays a solid reverse ramp and nails it over the keeper's head
Two dots and a wicket. Just the result KKR were hoping for. Slower legcutter outside off, Jansen looks to go over long-on, doesn't time it as well and Venkeatesh Iyer takes a simple catch
Another swing and a miss. Good length ball at 125kph outside off, he connects at thin air
On-pace length ball at 134kph well outside off. Jansen swings at it and misses.
Swung over long-on and Iyer ends the 18th over on a high. Slower back of a length ball outside off, but that sits up for Iyer who has hacked that miles.
Fuller well outside off, he toe-ends to long-off
Yorker again on off, Jansen digs it back to the bowler

Dropped by Arora at deep square leg. That really should have been taken. Low full toss on his pad, he flicks this straight to Arora who misjudged it big time. Should have taken a couple of steps forward, ends up staying rooted and then has to dive forward. Is completely out of position.
Another yorker right at Jansen's feet on off stump. He somehow digs it out and Iyer scampers through for a run
Yorker that tails back into Iyer on middle stump. He digs this to deep midwicket
Drags his length ball a touch and fires a 97kph delivery on middle and leg. Iyer works this to the on-side
Legbreak on off stump at 99kph, he prods half-forward and pushes to point with an open face of the bat to get off the mark

That's that! Maxwell's horror season continues as he falls to Varun for the fifth time in T20s. Seam up delivery at 110kph from Varun and he shortened the length as well outside off. Maxwell goes for a cut, misses and sees his off stump disturbed
And here's the famous Maxwell switch hit. Start of something? Darted outside off, he brings out the switch hit and plants him over short third
Flatter outside off stump, he punches to the right of extra cover, who dives and saves at least a run
Backs away but Varun follows him and cramps Iyer for room. He can only push this back to the bowler
Good length ball around middle and leg, Iyer works this to deep midwicket for a run
Another miscue. Fired in on middle at 94.5kph, he backs away looking to go up and over, only manages to drag this to deep square leg
Quicker length ball just around off, he pushes to point with an open face of the bat
Two, two, two is the call and they make it, comfortably. Slower through the air on middle and leg, he nudges this to the on-side with soft hands
Flatter length ball on off, he punches to long-on
Offbreak that turns back into Maxwell big time. He backs away, looking to go across the line, can only get a thick inside-edge onto pad
Goes on pace now at 132kph well outside off. He backs away but completely miscues this to the on-side
Off pace length ball outside off, he guides this to backward point
Slower legcutter just outside off as Maxwell is beaten with the ball going to the 'keeper on the bounce

Mistimed straight to Powell and Prabhsimran's masterclass ends on 83. Shin-high full toss well outside off. Prabhsimran was looking to go up and over, but perhaps tried to hit the ball too hard. The bat turns in his hand and Powell takes a comfortable catching running in from long-off
slower offcutter that grips and turns a little as Iyer opens the face of the bat and guides to short third
Fuller in length outside off, he carves this away to deep third for a run
Flatter on off, he backs away exposing his stumps and cuts this powerfully to deep point
Slog sweeps, reverse sweeps, switch hits... it's all coming off for Prabhsimran. Flatter outside leg stump, he goes the switch hit way and beats point's dive
Over Rinku this time around. Darted right in Prabhsimran's arc on middle stump, he brings out the slog sweep and hammers this over deep midwicket
Picks the one coming into Prabhsimran and finds the gap brilliantly. Flatter outside off, he slogs sweeps this to the right of Rinku for four more
Flatter on leg stump, he wears it on the pad

In the air and put down by Rana. He has hurt himself as well on those practice pitches. Was dragged down just a touch outside off, he pulls to the right of long-on. Rana dives but can't hang on. As he lands, he scrapes his elbow on the practice turf.

Lovely shot, top fielding effort and a direct hit. But Iyer is in, comfortably. Fuller length ball angling across the batter outside off. He carves this over point but Rana does so well to his left and saves two
Low full toss angling across Prabhsimran who cur-ends it to long-off
First the deft touch then the brute force. Slower back of a length ball at 119kph on middle stump. He gets across a touch and pulls him fiercely over deep square leg for six more/
And again! The deft touch in all it's glory. Slower good length ball just around off. He waits for it and at the last moment guides it to the left of point.

Shot, shouts Iyer from the non-striker's end and that shot gets Prabh his fifty. Top innings. Short of a length legcutter  outside off stump, he opens the face of the bat and runs this in the gap between short third and point
Slower offcutter on a good length outside off, he opens the face of the bat and taps to deep third for a quick run
Leading edge, just past Russell's outstretched left hand. On a length on off, he was looking to go on-side, gets it down to long-off instead

Finally, finally a wicket for KKR and golden arm Dre Russ gets on the board. Slower offcutter on a good length on middle and leg. Arya goes a pull, miscues it and Arora takes a comfortable catch at deep midwicket. Top innings, nevertheless
Going, going... gone! That is massive. Full outside off, he opens his wrists, gets under the ball and hammers him for an 89m six over deep extra cover
Yorker on middle that tails in late. Prabhsimran pushes to long-on
Fullish in length well outside off, he scythes this to deep point
Ooh, spanked but straight to extra cover. Was a half-volley outside off, he laces the drive but can't find the gap

Swatted straight down the ground and Prabhsimran  has taken full toll of that free hit. Flatter well outside off, trying to move away from Prabhsimran's hitting arc. It doesn't bother Prabhsimran as he goes through the line and straight over the bowler's head
Another switch hit attempt, to no avail this time. Narine slows this up big time on middle and leg, he can only miscue it to extra cover. Oh, hang on... Narine has overstepped.
Shortens the length just a touch on middle and leg as Arya works this to wide long-on
Stifle short on the stump, he works this to deep midwicket
WOWZA! What a hit that. Tossed up on leg stump, he goes the switch hit way and wallops him clean over deep extra cover for a huge six

Huge, huge appeal for lbw... not given. Ooh, that looks close. Will KKR review. Yes, they do, right at the last second. Two questions. Where did that pitch? Was there any glove/bat? Was a touch slower in the air on leg stump. Arya goes reverse, misses and is struck in front. But, he's got a bit of glove on that. KKR lose a review.

Oh, that's really a top shot. He didn't get to the pitch of it, he didn't have the room. But he still went for the shot, he still cleared the fence. Flatter on leg stump, he jumps down the track and lifts Narine clean over long-on. All bottom-hand on that
Full outside off, driven out behind point
Full and going down leg, he just glances it fine and it beats the short fine fielder. Fantastic fifty for Arya, off 27 balls
There is a fielder at deep point, but it doesn't matter! Takes on this wide yorker with the open face to loft it square on the off side! Fielder could only watch the ball sail over
Oh, so gracefully done! Made it look effortless. This is a slower ball, full on off and going across. Arya takes a small step forward with his front foot and just lofts it over cover
Low full toss around off, Prabhsimran looks to go inside out and miscues it to cover on the bounce
Full outside off, Prabhsimran looks to slog it away but can only get it out to midwicket off the inside half of the bat
Clipped behind square leg for a single. Quiet over again from Narine. Just seven off his two overs so far
Spins in some ways from a length on off to beat Prabhsimran's flick and bounces off the pads

A stunning dive, but he can't get there! This is a googly on leg, Arya goes for a slog sweep and skies it towards deep midwicket. Sakariya races in and dives in front at full stretch, but the ball falls short of him! Great effort nonetheless
Tossed up full on leg, squeezed square on the off side. They decide against the single
On a length on middle, tucked to the midwicket fielder
Tossed up around off, it spins in a little, Prabhsimran eases it in front of square leg for a single
Googly on a length outside off, chopped towards point on the bounce
Length ball on the pads, Prabhsimran swipes it away square on the leg side and they do well to take two as the deep backward square fielder puts in the dive at the boundary
Backs away to make room and looks to drive, Varun follows him and beats the bat. Goes to short fine off the keeper
A bit short and Arya cuts it out to deep point
You can't hold him back for too long! This is overpitched from Varun and Arya clears his front leg and slogs this over deep midwicket. Fast hands and Arya picks up his first six of the day
On a length around off, Prabhsimran backs away to slap it out to the off side sweeper
Pushed out to point for a single. The spinners have reined things in for KKR
Tossed up on leg and Arya eases it into the midwicket area for a single
Narine beats him this time! Full around off and it stays low to beat this booming drive down the ground
Priyansh looks to drive this away on the off side and it goes off the outside half to the backward point fielder
Prabhsimran gets in position to play the scoop early, Narine floats it full outside off and the batter adjusts to just paddle it fine on the leg side
Flung full around off, Arya lunges forward and clips this out to deep midwicket

Beats him with another beauty! Prabhsimran moves around in his crease and eventually looks to block this legbreak on a length and is lucky to not edge that. Good over from KKR's perspective to close out the powerplay
Prabhsimran brings out the slog sweep and finds nothing but air! This is a legbreak outside off, and it beats the bat comprehensively
Tossed on a length on leg, tucked out in front of square leg
On a length on leg and finishing around middle, Arya blocks
On a length around middle, spinning away, Priyansh pushes it to cover
On a length outside off, it spins in some ways and Prabhsimran eases it sqaure on the leg side
On a length around leg, steered to point
Drops this length ball on off towards cover for a quick single
Full around off, Prabhsimran clips this to midwicket

Shot of the day? It's a length ball on off, Prabhsimran goes across the stumps and scoops this over short fine leg and it goes all the way. The boundaries behind the wicket are quite short and Prabhsimran is primed to make use of those today!
On a length on middle, this beats Prabh's big swing across the line and goes over the stumps!
Short, wide and Prabhsimran gets low to slice this up and over between short third and backward point! One-bounce four. He saw width and played this smartly
Make that six fours in 11 balls! Length ball outside off sits up nicely and Arya jabs it away through midwicket
Full around leg, tucked towards midwicket for a single

And now Prabhsimran gets going! Skips down the ground, this time getting to the pitch of the ball as Sakariya pitches it full, and handsomely lofts it straight down the ground for the first six of the game. Just what he needed to get going today?
Short ball fired down leg. Gurbaz cheekily appeals for a nick as Prabhsimran has a wild swipe at it. Sees the umpire call it wide
On a length around off, punched out to the off side sweeper

Chipped in the gap and beats Russell to the rope! This is full and on the stumps, Arya clips it between midwicket and mid-on. Russell from mid-on gave it a chase, but the ball speeds up on this fast outfield. First boundary on the leg side today for Arya
Sakariya sees Prabhsimran backing away and followsh him. He is able to punch it out to cover and scamper for a single, helped by a slight fumble from the fielder

Driven in the air, but in the gap Slot ball outside off, and Arya again picks the gap between cover and mid-off with a little chip. A little to the left, or to the right, and the infielders may have fancied themselves, but Arya has been excellent with his placement
Yorker on middle, dug out to the off side
And now Vaibhav fires a full ball down leg
Oh beautiful placement! You don't want to bowl low full tosses to Arya! Calmly pushes it in the gap between mid-off and cover and picks up his third boundary off the quick
Pitched full and Prabhsimran again comes out of the crease but only manages to whip it out to deep square leg
Length ball angled across Arya who slashes it off the edge over point. Lands well short of the fielder in the deep running in
Full around leg, Prabhsimran comes down the ground and gets it out of the inside half of the bat to long-on
On a length down leg, tucked towards short fine for a single
Length ball around off, punched to point. The towel tucked in Sakariya's trousers falls out as he bowls this one
Short of good length ball angles in from oustide off, Arya tucks it square on the leg side
Back of length delivery angled across him, Prabhsimran runs it fine on the off side, to short third's right and gets a single as the deep backward point fielder gets across to collect
On a length around leg, Prabhsimran skips out of the crease but has to adjust and pushes it out to cover
Full around off, hint of swing into the right-hander, fended to the leg side

The change in angle doesn't matter! This is full outside off again, swinging away again, and this time Arya drives it to the cover fielder's right and gets the same result as he did at the start of the over
On a length around off, angling in, Prabhsimran tucks it to midwicket
On a length around off, Prabhsimran defends
Full, swinging away from Prabhsimran, who hits a punchy drive to mid-off
Vaibhav pulls back the length and Arya punches it out to point
Oh, beauty! This is full, just swinging away from the left-hander but Arya nails the drive through cover to start off with a boundary
Short around leg, finishing on off, blocked on the back foot
Looks to swing this leg side again and this time he misses. It goes off his thighs past the slip fielder to deep third's right
Swung away with disdain! Full on the pads and Narine does what Narine does and heaves it away well in front of the deep square leg fielder
Short outside off, Narine sways away. Looks for a wide call from the umpire, but there's no signal coming
On a length around leg, tucked square on the leg side for KKR's first run off the bat
Full and angled across him, pitching closer to off this time, left alone by Gurbaz
Starts off with a full ball angled across the opener, but this one is too wide
